column1: # Super Mario 64 in Super Mario 3D All-Stars (program 1 of application 010049900F546000; update 1.1.4 = v393216), SDK 10.8.1.
# Nintendo's N64 layer: the game's MIPS code statically recompiled to arm64 in an NRO (rom/Stardust_JP/05_UNSMJ3.002.nro, loaded with nn::ro), the rest through a JIT plugin
# (nro/EmuSystemJITPlugin.nro, run by the host's nn::jit, hle_jit.c). Renders with Vulkan (dm/gfx/vk/hle_vk.m). Packed one program at a time: the NSP script's --program 1
# not loaded, main takes nothing from them the host does not supply: subsdk0 (NintendoSDK_Vulkan), subsdk1 (NintendoSDK_OpenGL), subsdk2 (GLSLC)
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB − 520 MB of bss (counted as used memory): a 2816 MB heap region
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon (Big Brain Academy: Brain vs. Brain sets a heap only then)
# Super Mario 3D All-Stars' launcher (program 0) starts each game with oe::ExecuteProgram and a 16-byte parameter: the language code and two volumes (launcher main+0x10a54).
# The host runs this program by itself (the NSP script's --program), so the profile hands the game the same parameter
